You will receive an SMS/WhatsApp and E-mail with details of your order and order number on a successful order placement. You’ll receive another email & SMS/ WhatsApp once your order is shipped out. It means Cash on Delivery is not serviceable by our courier partners at your location postal code, but you can always opt for Net Banking or Credit/Debit Card payment options.
